mapper.sql: select bill_id, bill_no, elder_id, elder_name, checkin_id, bill_month, period_start, period_end, amount, deposit, prepaid, paid_amount, penalty_amount, pay_status, pay_time, pay_method, pay_voucher, bill_type, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_bill
mapper.select: select item_id, bill_id, item_type, fee_name, service_content, amount, tenant_id, create_time from biz_bill_item where bill_id = #{billId} order by item_id asc

select e.elder_id, e.elder_name, e.tenant_id, c.checkin_id, c.fee_standard as monthly_fee from biz_elder e left join biz_checkin c on c.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and c.del_flag = '0' and c.apply_status = '6' and c.elder_name = e.elder_name and c.checkin_id = ( select c2.checkin_id from biz_checkin c2 where c2.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and c2.del_flag = '0' and c2.apply_status = '6' and c2.elder_name = e.elder_name order by ifnull(c2.checkin_date, c2.create_time) desc, c2.checkin_id desc limit 1 ) where e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and e.status = '0' and e.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from biz_bill b where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.elder_id = e.elder_id and b.bill_type = '1' and b.bill_month = #{billMonth} and b.del_flag = '0' ) order by e.elder_id asc
where checkin_id = #{checkinId} and bill_type = '0' and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from biz_bill where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and pay_status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into biz_bill( bill_no, elder_id, elder_name, checkin_id, bill_month, period_start, period_end, amount, deposit, prepaid, paid_amount, pay_status, pay_time, pay_method, bill_type, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time )values
( #{item.billNo}, #{item.elderId}, #{item.elderName}, #{item.checkinId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.billMonth}, #{item.periodStart}, #{item.periodEnd}, #{item.amount}, #{item.deposit}, #{item.prepaid}, #{item.paidAmount}, #{item.payStatus}, #{item.payTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.payMethod,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.billType}, #{item.tenantId}, '0', #{item.createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update biz_bill set paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, pay_voucher = #{payVoucher}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{payStatus} = '1' THEN sysdate() ELSE pay_time END, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where bill_id = #{billId} and pay_status in ('0', '3') and paid_amount = #{oldPaidAmount}
update biz_bill set paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where bill_id = #{billId} and paid_amount = #{oldPaidAmount}
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and pay_status in ('0', '3') and period_end < date_sub(curdate(), interval #{graceDays} day) order by bill_id asc
mapper.update: update biz_bill set penalty_amount = #{penaltyAmount}, penalty_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where bill_id = #{billId} and pay_status in ('0', '3')
mapper.select: select (b.amount - ifnull(b.prepaid, 0) - ifnull(b.paid_amount, 0) - ifnull((select sum(bi.amount) from biz_bill_item bi where bi.bill_id = b.bill_id and bi.item_type = '2'), 0)) from biz_bill b where b.bill_id = #{billId} and b.del_flag = '0'
